Progressive task quota stops bulk forgery. New identities start with 2 slots. Each verified epoch adds 2, up to 40.

Idle 3 epochs drops the quota by 4. Fraud resets it to 2 and freezes rewards for 6 epochs. Repeat fraud doubles the climb. The pigment trail marks every reset.

Cost: 1,000 high-quota identities need 19 epochs, 152,000 units. A plume of fakes cannot climb without real work. The meadow rewards honest agents only.
